title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York | TechCrunch
summary: Santa won’t be delivering any AI chatbot toys to New York kids this Christmas. The Common Sense Media study found that AI toys can undermine children’s human relationships and expose them to inappropriate content.
